title: 第11章 夏皇的警告第12章 第二个伴生天赋求追读
slug: 暮年太子每天增加一点精神
content_zh:
“混账东西！”
紫宸殿中，金丝楠木雕琢的龙椅之上，夏皇正襟危坐，满脸都是怒火。
他的身形伟岸如山，一袭玄黑色绣金龙袍垂落，袖口金线勾勒的云纹在烛火下闪烁着冷厉的光。
面容宛若刀削一般，眉如利剑，眸似寒星，散发出的威严如渊如海，令人不敢直视。
他今年已经一百多岁，但是作为超品天人，足足有五百年寿命，一百多岁对他来说，正是风华正茂的时候。
夏无恙的模样跟他有几分相似，但若是与夏圣鸣站在一起，别人只会以为夏无恙是父亲，夏圣鸣是儿子。
东宫太医李云亭额头紧贴地面，冷汗浸透了官袍，颤声说道：“回禀陛下，太子殿下……近日被龟兹舞女所迷，身体亏损严重，只能向内库讨要更好的龙虎大药，或者是奇宝调养。”
之前夏无恙所服用的滋补丹药，也就是龙虎大药，基本上都是低级龙虎大药，正常情况下足以供给下三品的武者服用。
夏无恙一个未曾入品的普通人，服用低级龙虎大药已经有些奢侈，但是他的身体情况不容乐观，到处千疮百孔，丹药进入体内就会漏出去，只有小部分能够生效。
低级龙虎大药的药效虽然厉害，在他身上也就发挥出数十分之一的效果。
如今讨要更好的中级龙虎大药，甚至是奇宝，在外界看来自然是因为身体状况更差了，连低级龙虎大药都不堪使用了。
奇宝乃是能够直接提升修为境界的宝物，自然也能够大大地滋补身体，不过若是用来滋补身体的话，那就太暴殄天物。
即使在内库之中，奇宝的数量也极为有限，每一样都需要夏皇首肯，这才能够拿走。
“砰……”
夏皇一掌拍在龙案上，整座大殿都在这一掌之下颤动着，案上的奏折、砚台、玉玺……齐齐跳起，墨汁溅落在明黄色的绸缎上，如泼墨般刺目。
“寡人宫中尚且没有龟兹舞女，他倒是挺会享受的。夜夜笙歌，荒淫无度，看来他是真不想活了。”
听闻此言，殿中的宫女太监已经吓得跪伏在地，太医李云亭也是浑身发抖：“陛下息怒，太子殿下或许是……或许是……”
他也不知道该如何跟夏皇解释，夏皇冷笑：“或许是什么，或许是觉得自己命长，想要早点去见他的母后？”
李云亭说不出话来，其他人闭嘴不言，一片死寂，殿中只余灯火爆裂的细响。
“传旨……以后太子可以随意取用中级龙虎大药，至于奇宝的话，先赐他一瓶天水精华。”

良久，夏皇深吸一口气，强行压下怒火，冷冷地朝着李云亭看了过去。
李云亭愕然抬头，有些难以置信：“陛下……您答应了？”
“呵呵……”
夏皇森然一笑：“他不要体面，难道寡人还不要体面，总不能让他死在女人的肚皮上，回去以后告诉夏无恙，若是他真死在了女人的肚皮上，身后事就不用再办了，寡人没有他这样的逆子。”
话语声中，夏皇眼眸中浮现出怒火，缓缓起身，龙袍垂落之间，一股无形的威压如潮水般扩散，连空气都仿佛凝滞了下来。
殿内侍立的太监宫女面露愕然，却不敢发出半点儿声音，生怕一个不小心惹到了陛下。
李云亭的心中也有些发寒，暗道若是夏无恙真死在了女人身上，连身后事也办不了的话，岂不是意味着夏皇不承认他这个儿子，也不承认这个太子了。
content_en:
"Bastard thing!"
In the Zichen Palace, on the dragon chair carved from golden nanmu, Emperor Xia sat upright, his face full of anger.
His figure was as majestic as a mountain, and he wore a black dragon robe embroidered with gold hanging down, and the cloud patterns outlined with gold thread on the cuffs shone coldly under the candlelight.
His face is as sharp as a knife, his eyebrows are like sharp swords, and his eyes are like cold stars. He exudes a majesty like an abyss or an ocean, making people dare not look directly at him.
He is over a hundred years old this year, but as a transcendent heavenly being, he has a lifespan of five hundred years. For him, being over a hundred years old is the time to be in his prime.
Xia Wuyang's appearance was somewhat similar to his, but if he stood with Xia Shengming, others would only think that Xia Wuyang was the father and Xia Shengming was the son.
Li Yunting, the imperial physician of the East Palace, pressed his forehead to the ground, his official robe soaked with cold sweat, and said in a trembling voice: "Reporting to Your Majesty, His Royal Highness... Recently, he was fascinated by the Qiuci dancing girl, and his body suffered serious losses. He can only ask for better dragon and tiger medicine from the inner treasury, or some rare treasures to nurse him back to health."
The nourishing elixirs that Xia Wuhuang took before, that is, the dragon and tiger medicines, were basically low-level dragon and tiger medicines. Under normal circumstances, they were enough for lower-level third-level warriors.
Xia Wuyang was an ordinary person who had never entered the first-class medicine. Taking low-level dragon and tiger medicine was already a bit luxurious, but his physical condition was not optimistic.
Although the efficacy of the low-level dragon and tiger medicine was powerful, it only exerted a tenth of the effect on him.
Nowadays, if you ask for better mid-level dragon and tiger medicine, or even Qibao, in the eyes of the outside world, it is naturally because your physical condition is getting worse, and even the low-level dragon and tiger medicine cannot be used.
Qibao is a treasure that can directly improve the level of cultivation. Naturally, it can also greatly nourish the body. However, if it is used to nourish the body, it would be a waste of natural resources.
Even in the inner treasury, the number of rare treasures is extremely limited, and each item requires the approval of Emperor Xia before it can be taken away.
"Bang..."
Emperor Xia slapped his palm on the dragon table, and the whole hall trembled under this palm. The memorials, inkstones, and jade seals on the table all jumped up, and the ink splashed on the bright yellow silk and satin, which was as dazzling as splashed ink.
"There are no Qiuci dancers in the palace, but he does enjoy it quite a lot. He plays and sings every night and is extravagant. It seems that he really doesn't want to live anymore."
After hearing this, the maids and eunuchs in the palace were so frightened that they knelt on the ground. The imperial doctor Li Yunting was also trembling all over: "Your Majesty, please calm down. Your Highness, the Crown Prince may be... maybe..."
He didn't know how to explain it to Emperor Xia. Emperor Xia sneered: "Maybe what? Maybe he thinks he has a long life and wants to see his mother as soon as possible?"
Li Yunting was speechless, and the others kept silent. There was dead silence, and the only sound left in the hall was the crackling sound of lights.
"The decree... From now on, the prince can freely use the intermediate dragon and tiger medicine. As for Qibao, give him a bottle of heavenly water essence first."
After a long time, Emperor Xia took a deep breath, suppressed his anger, and looked at Li Yunting coldly.
Li Yunting raised his head in astonishment and said in disbelief: "Your Majesty...you agreed?"
"Haha..."
Emperor Xia smiled solemnly: "He doesn't want dignity. Don't I want dignity? I can't let him die on a woman's belly. When I go back, tell Xia Wuxu that if he really dies on a woman's belly, there will be no need to deal with the affairs after his death. I don't have a rebellious son like him."
As he spoke, anger appeared in Emperor Xia's eyes, and he stood up slowly. When the dragon robe fell, an invisible pressure spread like a tide, and even the air seemed to be stagnant.
The eunuchs and maids serving in the palace looked astonished, but they did not dare to make a sound, for fear of accidentally offending His Majesty.
Li Yunting also felt a little chill in his heart. He thought to himself that if Xia Wuyang really died on a woman and couldn't even deal with his posthumous affairs, wouldn't it mean that Emperor Xia didn't recognize him as his son, nor did he recognize this person?A prince.
